reviews.text:
I brought my 3-month-old puppy, Loki, and found someone knowledgeable, helpful, and very attentive to the puppy's well-being. A wonderful experience for both my puppy and me.
Thank you!

I took my Thor to this shop for the first time. The place was very nice, and Gaia was super empathetic. He came home clean and smelled good, and most importantly, he wasn't stressed at all when I arrived. Thank you! Highly recommended!
Leo the poodle's first experience. Gaia was excellent, professional, and very attentive to our requests. I highly recommend her. See you next time. This is Leo from Aunt Gaia.
Very good and very patient even with shy and scared animals.

Ares came home happy, clean, smelling good, and super tidy.
Gaia is very kind and helpful, and she knows how to put even dogs who aren't very happy with being handled, like me, at ease.

Excellent! Nothing else to say! ♥️
Perfect grooming for both my dogs!
Thank you so much ✨ ♥️

I brought my big cat here and I can't help but have wonderful words for Gaia! She's incredibly sweet, patient, and talented. Even though my Casper wasn't very cooperative during the drying process, she was able to calm him down and immediately put both of us at ease. I highly recommend her ❤️❤️❤️

Very professional and patient 🐾❤️
Now trimming Chicco's nails has become enjoyable and very convenient since it's close to home🥰 …

I have a 40-kg Labrador who's definitely traumatized by grooming. Getting him professionally washed has always been a huge undertaking, especially for those who care for him. For years, we gave up, opting for a DIY grooming... then we discovered Gaia.
Gaia is a woman with a rare sweetness and kindness with our four-legged friends. Despite his initial fear, my Sam has overcome the ordeal, and I'm sure that, session after session, he will gain more and more confidence.
From a "technical" standpoint: a truly lovely location, competitive prices, and—most importantly for me—no rush in handling the dog.
I highly recommend her!

After moving after many years, I was forced to change groomers, but it couldn't have happened better.
Gaia is a wonderful person: sweet, affectionate, and patient.
Now you're our safe haven because, beyond experience, what really makes the difference is the passion you put into your work.
Thank you from Toni and Piero 🐾❤️
A truly positive experience! Today I took my two large dogs, Fernando and Eliot. Gaia was excellent and very professional. I highly recommend her! See you soon.
I took my 90-pound Balto to the groomer, and he came out super soft and wearing a gorgeous bandana. Great price, thanks so much, see you next time!
I brought my toy poodle puppy today...what can I say...Gaia is fantastic and had a very sweet approach to my Simba! Highly recommended!

Today I took Marra and Trudy for a grooming session, and I can say I had a wonderful experience in every way. You can really see when someone works with love, passion, and attention: my dogs came out smelling wonderful, soft, and well-groomed.
One gesture that won me over was the sweetness of adding Christmas bandanas to Marra and Trudy's necks, a very sweet touch and perfectly in keeping with the holidays 🎄✨. Plus, she also gave us some cookies, an extra treat that really makes a difference.
All this at a super competitive price, decidedly low compared to the high quality of the service offered. It's rare to find such a perfect balance between professionalism, care, and affordability.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a grooming experience done with love. We'll definitely be back! 💕🐶
Lots of patience and super kind!! 10/10

We just moved to the area, so Romeo and I stayed here for the first time. Gaia was super kind and professional. She described everything she'd done to the dog. Romeo loved the biscuits, especially the scent, and especially the Christmas bandana. 💖
We'll definitely be back.
New shop in the area, equipment in excellent condition, and impeccable results. Quick, clean, and stress-free wash for the dog. Highly recommended.

We took our schnauzer for a wash and clip, and we had a great time. The cut was done well, and the shop is nice and well-maintained. Gaia is kind and helpful; I really appreciated how she stayed after the grooming to give us a detailed description of how it went and how the dog had behaved. We'll definitely be back :)
We brought our medium-sized female dog. We had a great time: the dog was pampered and smelled wonderful. I highly recommend it!
